major: Custom language support: Personalize MIRO by overriding any UI text/labels with custom language files.
minor: Cleaner workspace: Key controls (e.g., switch between table ↔ chart) moved into the header; spacing & layout tweaks reduce clutter.
UI polish: Light mode navbar is now white; dark mode primary switches to blue.
Faster workflow: Load data and Solve model buttons are also available in the output section.
What's New: Added a What's New dialog in the Help menu and to the MIRO Desktop library.
GAMS Engine Settings: New dialog in Help shows remaining GAMS Engine quota and (where supported) lets you change the default instance.
MIRO Desktop library: Redesigned initial screen (no apps) and general design improvements.
MIRO Desktop library: App launch is simpler - each app card is now fully clickable (no separate button).

Dashboard and dashboard Compare - Filters: Configure default selections (explicit or positional), choose single vs. multi-select per dimension, and set control labels/placeholders. Legacy userFilter arrays are deprecated but still supported.
Dashboard and dashboard Compare: Tables now display your customized column headers.
MIRO Pivot: Control the number of decimals shown in the table/chart.
MIRO Pivot: Pie/doughnut charts now limit displayed series to 40 for readability.
